episodes.title: Black Dog
episodes.summary: Jenny's first case as a coroner affects her personally, as she is called to investigate the death of a teen in a youth detention centre; her own life is upended by the death of her husband; she learns to navigate raising a teenage son on her own.

episodes.title: Bunny
episodes.summary: When Jenny is called to a luxe condo to investigate the death of cannabis mogul Vic Stenton, she enters an alternate world where nothing is as it seems; Jenny starts to figure out what it means to live life as a widow, including the good and bad.

episodes.title: Scattered

episodes.title: Quick or Dead
episodes.summary: Jenny chases a killer who is leaving a bloody trail across the city and has been in contact with her son.

episodes.title: All's Well
episodes.summary: Jenny hosts Thanksgiving at home with her dad and mother-in-law. But when the plumbing breaks down, her work life and personal life collide in the worst possible way.

episodes.title: Confetti Heart
episodes.summary: Jenny conducts her first inquest into a police shooting as Detective McAvoy confronts the brotherhood of blue.

episodes.title: The Suburbs
episodes.summary: The coroner's building is on lockdown, and Jenny is isolated from her team with a blast from the past. Detective McAvoy is on the hunt for a newly released killer.

episodes.title: Bridges
episodes.summary: After the untimely death of a co-worker, Jenny and Detective McAvoy dig up clues that lead back to a serial killer.

episodes.title: Fire
episodes.summary: As Jenny investigates a devastating fire in a low-income apartment building, she connects with a woman who has lost everything.

episodes.title: Borders
episodes.summary: Jenny investigates a body found in the middle of a country road with no ID, and few clues to how he got there.

episodes.summary: Jenny and Donovan investigate the death of a lab assistant, but Jenny's personal interest in the lab risks clouding the case.

episodes.title: Unburied
episodes.summary: Jenny investigates two grisly deaths in the suburbs, and an unreliable witness complicates matters.

episodes.title: Monster in the House
episodes.summary: Jenny must trust her instincts as she takes on a new enemy that threatens to undermine her career, her family, and her own judgment.

episodes.title: Fire Part 2
episodes.summary: Jenny and Donovan must race to confirm their suspicions before a dangerous suspect gets away.

episodes.title: Bobby
episodes.summary: In the wake of COVID-19, Jenny investigates the mysterious death of a care worker whose body is found in her own car.

episodes.title: Spirits
episodes.summary: Jenny and Donovan investigate a mysterious death in a haunted house.

episodes.title: Eyes Up
episodes.summary: Jenny and Donovan help a young girl who seeks the truth about her father's death.

episodes.title: Back to the Future
episodes.summary: After a gruesome discovery at a body farm, Jenny and Donovan unearth a small town's tragic secrets.

episodes.title: No Justice, No Peace
episodes.summary: After a night of partying, Ross finds himself embroiled in a murder investigation.

episodes.title: Round and Round
episodes.summary: A deceased John Doe forces Jenny and Clark to work together in the world of narcotics and therapy.

episodes.title: Blue Flock
episodes.summary: Jenny and Donovan confront personal dilemmas while they investigate a body on ice.

episodes.title: Christmas Eve
episodes.summary: Jenny and Mac investigate a Christmas Eve family brunch gone very wrong.

episodes.title: Christmas Day
episodes.summary: Jenny and Donovan are lured to a dangerous, remote location in search of the suspect in the Browning murders.

episodes.summary: Struggling with the loss of Liam, Jenny tries to take a vacation from death and happens across a mysterious dead body that stirs suspicion in a small town.

episodes.title: Cutting Corners
episodes.summary: Jenny clashes with her replacement coroner as they navigate the decedents of a fatal car crash.

episodes.summary: The death of an elderly Chinese restaurant owner sparks outrage in a rapidly gentrifying Chinatown.

episodes.summary: Gordon and Peggy's plans for a romantic weekend go awry when Jenny falls ill and must oversee a remote autopsy. Watch now.

episodes.title: LJND
episodes.summary: Suspicious deaths lead to uncomfortable truths as Jenny, Donovan and Malik come face to face with a monster in their midst.

episodes.title: Our Home on Native Land
episodes.summary: Jenny and Donovan investigate a death in Tkaronto's unhoused community, shedding light on a major housing problem.

episodes.title: Safe Space
episodes.summary: Death follows River and Dennis as they move into a new loft. A bereaved Peggy is missing.

episodes.title: Blast to the Past
episodes.summary: Jenny and Donovan set out to find out where Peggy is and who is responsible for the explosion at Peggy's shop.

episodes.title: Death Goes On
episodes.summary: Jenny and Peggy are forced to face one another in a crazed scramble for life. A case involving a known gangster makes Donovan reconsider his future.
